high_school_european_history:test:153.title: West in the treaty, east in the key
high_school_european_history:test:153.explanation: Article III explicitly removes Russian sovereignty over territories lying “to the west” of the agreed line. Option C describes the western part of the Russian Empire; the supplied key instead selects D, the eastern part. This direction reversal is directly checkable against the supplied text. The original key is displayed for inspection, not silently corrected.
evidence: The territories lying to the west
